fi-hemichromis-bimaculatus.title: Jewel Cichlid
fi-hemichromis-bimaculatus.summary: The jewel cichlid, Hemichromis bimaculatus, is a cichlid from Africa's western coast, between southern Guinea and central Liberia. Regularly seen in the trade and often sold as a community fish, it…
rows: Pairs or small groups depending on setup
Will eat nearly anything offered, though live foods will help to enhance the colouration of the fish.
Widespread down Africa 's western coast from South Guinea to Central Liberia .
notes: Provide a roomy aquarium with as many hiding places as possible to help disperse aggresion and provide sanctuary.
This can be achieved through the use of clay flower pots, rockwork arranged to form caves, driftwood and areas of dense planting.

fi-pelvicachromis-pulcher.title: Pelvicachromis pulcher
fi-pelvicachromis-pulcher.summary: The kribensis, Pelvicachromis pulcher, is a cichlid from Nigeria and Cameroon, found in still and slow-moving, heavily vegetated waters. One of the most common cichlids in the hobby since the 1950s,…
rows: Pairs or small groups depending on setup
notes: The tank should contain plenty of hiding places and potential spawning sites.
Clay pots and caves, roots and pieces of driftwood can all be used.

fi-etroplus-maculatus.title: Red Chromide Cichlid
fi-etroplus-maculatus.summary: The orange chromide, Pseudetroplus maculatus, is a euryhaline cichlid native to peninsular India and Sri Lanka. It mostly inhabits brackish estuaries, coastal lagoons and the lower reaches of rivers,…
rows: Aggressive / best alone or carefully chosen tankmates
group of 8+ individuals should therefore be the minimum purchase and these will form a noticeable dominance hierarchy once sexual maturity is reached.

Herbivore / algae browser. Observations of wild fish suggest it to be something of a generalist with a tendency to graze aufwuchs and filamentous algae from solid surfaces although it has been observed acting as a 'cleaner' for the congener E.
Native to peninsular India and Sri Lanka .
notes: This species can be maintained in fresh or brackish water so long as acidic conditions are avoided.

Décor is largely down to personal choice although a degree of structure, perhaps incorporating a sandy substrate, variably-shaped rocks and some driftwood branches, would adequately simulate natural conditions.

fi-hemichromis-lifalili.title: Red Lifalili Jewel Cichlid
fi-hemichromis-lifalili.summary: The blood-red jewel cichlid, Hemichromis lifalili, is a cichlid endemic to the Democratic Republic of Congo. Often confused with H. bimaculatus, it has two black spots on the flanks against that…
rows: Aggressive / best alone or carefully chosen tankmates
Schooling / social — keep a proper group
Herbivore / algae browser. Primarily carnivorous , but will accept virtually anything offered.
Endemic to the Democratic Republic of Congo.
notes: Provide a roomy aquarium with as many hiding places as possible to help disperse aggresion and provide sanctuary.
This can be achieved through the use of clay flower pots, rockwork (arrange this to form caves), driftwood and areas of dense planting.
